Frequently Asked Questions

Good to know before you ask

Do I need to stop advertising on Facebook?

No. Your website is designed to complement your existing marketing. Facebook can continue attracting potential renters while your website gives them somewhere to learn more.

Do guests book directly through the website?

Your starter website can include a guest inquiry form. If you need more advanced booking functionality, we can discuss the appropriate custom solution.

Can I show my rates?

Yes. Your website can include rental rates and seasonal pricing information.

Can I show availability?

Yes. Availability information can be incorporated into the website. The best approach depends on how you currently manage your rental calendar.

Can I add lots of cottage photos?

Yes. Strong photography is one of the most important parts of a vacation rental website, and your property gallery can showcase the experience of staying there.

Can you include nearby attractions?

Yes. A local-area section can help guests discover beaches, restaurants, attractions, wineries, golf, shopping and other things to do around your property.

I don't have a logo or rental brand yet.

That's okay. Deep Cortex Designs can also help develop branding and marketing materials for your property.

Do you only build websites for Sherkston Shores?

No. Deep Cortex Designs works virtually with private cottage and vacation rental owners across Canada.

How much does a vacation rental website cost?

Starter vacation rental websites begin at $499 CAD. More customized requirements can be quoted separately.

What is the Free Website Preview?

I'll create a personalized homepage concept showing a possible design direction for your rental. It lets you see the idea before deciding whether you'd like to proceed with a complete website.
